decision: Selected the centroid of the current Bulloch County parcel polygon (PIN 7887-33-7607, 27.05 geodesic acres) that contains the official 9-1-1 address point for 6539 Burkhalter Rd, the address named by Statesboro rezoning case RZ 26-07-05 for a proposed data center, as the project locator. The conceptual building footprint inside the parcel is not located.

selected_properties.layer: Bulloch_Parcel_layer (FeatureServer layer 10), Statesboro-Bulloch County GIS (stabull.org); no parcel number, owner or edit-date attributes are published in this layer

computed.method: Polygon ring returned by the service with outSR=4326 (native EPSG:2239, NAD83 Georgia East ftUS); centroid computed in EPSG:32617 and returned to WGS84; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid
computed.native_crs_cross_check: Centroid of the native EPSG:2239 ring transformed locally with pyproj: (-81.7531034, 32.4013947), 0.76 m from the selected point
computed.tools: pyproj 3.7.1, shapely 2.1.1 (scripts kept in the session scratchpad: statesboro_geom.py, statesboro_final.py)

identity_bridge: Statesboro City Council minutes of 18 August 2026 (agenda item 8): application RZ 26-07-05 by 4AM Development, LLC for a zoning map amendment from R-4 to O (Office and Business District) for one parcel of 26.49 acres at 6539 Burkhalter Road for a proposed data center, listed as Tax Parcel 101 000001 000; approved 3-2. Staff describe the site as containing an older single-family home, lying between a solar farm and residential subdivisions, with a conceptual 230,000 sq ft two-story facility centred on the parcel.
Bulloch County 9-1-1 address layer (stabull.org Bulloch_addresses, layer 6): exactly one ACTIVE point for 6539 BURKHALTER RD (modified 2026-01-23) at (-81.7539024, 32.3995916).
That address point lies inside the current parcel polygon PIN 7887-33-7607 (27.05 geodesic acres, layer acreage 27.046), consistent with the 26.49 acres stated in the minutes (2.1% difference).

The 2022 Bulloch County parcel table (Bulloch_Parcels MapServer, 'Bulloch GIS 2022') lists 6539 BURKHALTER RD as parcel 108 000001 000 (PIN 7887-44-0136, 50 acres, county zoning R-40/AG-5). The current polygons 7887-33-7607 (27.05 ac) and 7887-44-4600 (23.76 ac) together reproduce that 50.63-acre parcel (union/2022 area ratio 1.004), so the 2022 parcel has been split and the addressed part is 7887-33-7607.

The Statesboro zoning layer (Statesboro_Zoning MapServer, the city's definitive zoning layer) maps a polygon coded S(O) (Statesboro Office) of 27.99 geodesic acres that contains 99.99% of parcel 7887-33-7607; the minutes record the parcel as R-4 before the 18 August decision, so the layer reflects the approved rezoning.

consistency_checks.parcel_number_discrepancy: The minutes and action agenda print the tax parcel as 101 000001 000. No parcel with a 101 map prefix exists in the 2022 county parcel table, which gives the address as 108 000001 000 before the split; the current parcel layer publishes PINs only. The identity therefore rests on the street address, the acreage and the rezoned zoning polygon, not on the printed parcel number.
consistency_checks.vintage: The current parcel layer carries no edit dates; it post-dates the 2022 table because it shows the split. The address point was modified 2026-01-23 and the zoning layer already shows the 18 August 2026 rezoning.
consistency_checks.personal_data: Owner-name and contact fields of the county layers were not requested; only parcel, PIN, acreage, address and zoning attributes were retrieved.
